summary: Interpreted the no-snapshot receipt and closed that child question. The child question is marked explained, its limits recorded (construction-state observation with a 300 ms settle, harness-arranged absence of snapshots rather than a store failure, in-memory stores with scaled timeouts, one run per mode), and the counterevidence noted (the control rebuilds the membership, and the FSM replay rules out missing entries as the cause).
